title: 熱力学Ⅱ
subtitle: Thermodynamics II
keywords: The Carnot cycle 2.The second law of thermodynamics 3.Entropy 4.Real Gas 5.Thermal cycles
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Learn basic knowledge of the irreversibility in the nature world (2) Learn how to convert energy and obtain work from heat (3) Acquire design skills for energy conversion in mechanical engineering
advice: This is an advanced course in thermodynamics that follows Thermodynamics I. We will cover the following topics: 1. The Carnot cycle 2. The 2nd law of thermodynamics 3. Entropy 4. Thermal characteristics of real gas 5. Gas cycles Students are expected to understand the meaning of terms and formulas. Students are expected to solve exercises independently. Students should be aware of the teacher's instructions in the class, because the schedules of quizzes, tests, and reports may change as the class progresses. Students should not be absent from class, as they may not receive the handouts. Detailed schedules and content of the course are explained in the first class.
books: Textbook : Koguchi et al., Thermodynamics (in Japanese), Asakura shoten. Reference book : Arai, Furuhata, English-Japanese Bilingual Textbook Series, Thermodynamics, Morikita. Reserved books : N/A
requiredKnowledge: Have sufficient skill in mathematics (especially differential and integral calculations). Know how to use a calculator.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the Carnot cycle and apply it to problems
Be able to explain the 2nd law of thermodynamics and apply it to problems
Be able to explain entropy and apply it to problems
Be able to explain the characteristics of a real gas with phase change and apply it to problems
Be able to explain gas cycles and apply the knowledge to probrems about design of thermal equipment

Also, use this understanding to solve advanced problems related to thermal issues. (4) Explain the various gas cycles and the vapor cycle with P-V and T-S diagrams.
